ER_path: Parameters.load hard-sets Ca_dyn=False. No enablement inferred from handler flags.
first_scope: Supplied ordinary FULL/ECM SIM entry, bounded nonempty native chemistry/ECM transport; no whole initializer/phase/persistence claim.

general_configuration_obstruction.exact_obstruction: Absent general network leaves molecules_enabled unwritten; the else sets only mol_mit_enabled=False. No automatic false default is admitted.
general_configuration_obstruction.explicit_present_configuration: implement network is the independent general-handler flag; explicit True and False supported

calls.callee: np.sqrt(np.dot(p.NAv * p.q ** 2 * self.zs ** 2 / (p.er * p.eo * p.kb * p.T), self.cc_env)).mean
np.sqrt(np.dot(p.NAv * p.q ** 2 * self.zs ** 2 / (p.er * p.eo * p.kb * p.T), self.cc_cells)).mean
np.asarray([z ** 2 * p.q * p.F * cc * D / (p.kb * p.T) for z, cc, D in zip(self.zs, self.cc_cells, self.D_free)]).sum(axis=0).mean
np.asarray([z ** 2 * p.q * p.F * cc * D * 0.1 / (p.kb * p.T) for z, cc, D in zip(self.zs, self.cc_cells, self.D_free)]).sum
np.asarray([z ** 2 * p.q * p.F * cc * D / (p.kb * p.T) for z, cc, D in zip(self.zs, self.cc_env, self.D_env)]).sum
np.asarray([z ** 2 * p.q * p.F * cc * D / (p.kb * p.T) for z, cc, D in zip(self.zs, self.cc_cells, self.D_free)]).sum

molecular_namespaces: Each owner has independent same-named molecular dictionaries and cache; cross-owner X/Y aliasing is forbidden.
osmotic_rule: Source adds current concentrations from each enabled owner independently.
shared_publication_rule: Last enabled source writer replaces shared charge/current arrays; publication false retains incoming shared arrays. Never sum network publications.
